title: Scaffold State
description: Canonical format for scaffold-state.json — written by token-figma-scaffold, read by token-push, token-apply, token-generate, and token-bridge. Defines the Figma collection IDs, mode IDs, and variable ID index needed by downstream skills.

figma_file_url.description: URL of the Figma file these IDs belong to

collection_ids.description: Map of collection name to Figma collection ID

primitives.description: ID of the Primitives collection (hidden from publishing)

components.description: ID of the Components collection, or null if not used

mode_ids.description: Map of mode name (lowercase) to Figma mode ID. Includes all modes across all collections.

variable_ids.description: Map of token name to Figma variable ID. Populated incrementally as variables are created. Used as alias targets by downstream skills.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the scaffold was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update to this file
